description: Ordered, executable runbook for connecting a user to Martini (the sponsor's full-stack AI film studio) with the fewest human steps: a resumable state model (needs_account → needs_authorization → needs_billing → needs_project → ready), the human steps, agent steps tailored to the client and whether the agent has a shell or a browser, the quote-first generation contract, structured cost facts, when not to use Martini, and links. Facts verified 2026-10-26.

can_open_browser.description: Can the agent itself complete a browser OAuth sign-in (attach a connector)? Default false: the human does it.

client.description: The MCP client the user is in. Default other.

has_shell.description: Can the agent run commands (npm, martini CLI)? Default false.

name: get_martini_setup
title: Get the Martini connection runbook
